title: Recurring Ancillary Services Held Back from Resident Funds Withdrawals
content:
When a Resident Trust Fund Accounts account's spare amount is worked out for a withdrawal, **the recurring services kept** are held back from it. They follow the resident's most recent request to start a recurring service (cable television, telephone or an oxygen concentrator) on the resident's account under Ancillary and Optional Services Billing (of two made at the same moment, the one recorded first):

| Requests on the ancillary account | Recurring services kept |
|---|---|
| the request was made within the last thirty days, and no later request cancels a recurring service | the monthly price of that service on the ancillary account's tier |
| the request was made earlier, and no later request cancels a recurring service | the amount of that service's most recent monthly charge |
| otherwise | nothing |

"Within the last thirty days" means fewer than 30 calendar days before today.

## Hypothetical illustration

| Most recent start request | Later cancel request | Recurring services kept |
|---|---|---|
| telephone, 9 days ago | none | the telephone monthly price of the ancillary tier |
| cable television, 30 days ago | none | the amount of the most recent cable television monthly charge |
| oxygen concentrator, 12 days ago | a cancel request 4 days ago | nothing |
| none | — | nothing |
